layout.$description: Layout sizes in rem (1rem = the entry text size), so 'large text' changes the density as a whole: plate padding, gaps, row and field heights. The px values are at a 13 px root (font.root.default).

measure.$description: Text column width in characters (ch): it depends on the font and the text scale, so the column keeps the number of characters per line.

text.$description: The text column on Storybook pages and lead-ins.

page.$description: Maximum width of the Storybook 'Основа' (Foundation) page.

column.$description: Minimum column width in the card grid on the 'Основа' (Foundation) pages.

measure.$description: Maximum plate width: about 65 characters of Russian Inter text, 60-68 per line (ADR-0004; ch is measured by the digit '0', which is wider than an average letter; the value was refined from a screenshot).

padding-block.$description: Inner padding of a plate at the top and bottom (7.8 px; D2: was 6.5).

padding-inline.$description: Inner padding of a plate on the left and right (12.35 px; D2: was 9.75).

gap-series.$description: The gap between plates of one series: a pause of under 5 minutes (4.55 px; D2: was 3.25).

gap-group.$description: The gap between series and around the day label (13 px; D2: was 9.75).

time-reserve.$description: Room for the time '09:12' at the end of the last text line (about 40 px; D2: was 38): the time sits in the bottom right corner of the plate, and the text does not cover it.

agent-mark-reserve.$description: Extra room at the end of the last line of an agent entry for the quiet 'added by agent ·' mark to the left of the time (about 131 px, slice 4a; D2: was 124).

size.$description: The task square '- [ ]' in a message (14 px).

tick-width.$description: Checked task tick: the width of the short side of the rotated rectangle (4 px).

tick-left.$description: Checked task tick: the offset from the left inside the square (3.6 px).

tick-top.$description: Checked task tick: the offset from the top inside the square (0.8 px).

column.$description: Width of the feed and input field column in the center of the chat area: 668 px at a 13 px root. In a narrow window the column takes the whole width minus the margins.

padding-inline.$description: The feed margin on the left and right (26 px; D2: was 19.5).

padding-block.$description: The feed margin at the top and bottom (19.5 px; D2: was 9.75).

padding.$description: The sidebar margin around the search and the chat list (9.75 px; D2: was 6.5).

size.$description: A chat tile in the sidebar, the icon slot of the lower items and the profile avatar (22.75 px, D2).

size-small.$description: A chat tile in a line of small text (search hits, trash plates; KINIG-59): 14.3 px, the line height of type.meta, so the line does not grow. About the size the chat emoji had there before tiles.

letter-small.$description: The letter in a small tile (9.1 px).

size.$description: A round avatar with initials in the profile row (22.75 px): the same size as a chat tile, so the lower rows keep one rhythm.

dot.$description: The status dot at the avatar (8 px), not shown in D1.

height.$description: List row height: a menu item, a copy, a settings row (33.8 px; D2: was 32.5). Sidebar rows are taller: layout.sidebar.row-height.
Height of a single-line input field: the search (35 px; D2: was 30).

min-height.$description: Minimum height of an input field with buttons (52 px; D2: was 45.5).

max-height.$description: The field grows up to 40% of the window height, beyond that it scrolls inside (PRD §5).

size.$description: A small button in the action row (21 px).

gap.$description: A transparent gap between the plate and the action row to its right (6.5 px); mouse hover extends into it.

offset.$description: Offset of the row from the right edge of the plate when there is no room on the right and the row stands above the plate at its right edge; at the top edge of the feed, also from the top edge of the plate (3.25 px).

height.$description: Height of a button and an icon button (32.5 px; D2: was 30).

offset.$description: Offset of a toast from the bottom edge of the feed: above the input field (71.5 px).

width.$description: Width of the modal 'Settings' window (546 px at a 13 px root); in a narrow window the panel takes the window width minus the margins.

max-height.$description: Largest height of a modal window panel: above it the content scrolls inside the panel, the title and the close button stay in place.

settings.$description: The 'Settings' window (slice 4b): a separate OS window with a section tree on the left and one scrollable page on the right.

window-width.$description: Initial width of the OS window (logical px). The window is created by Rust, the values match the `settings_window` constants (checked by the configuration test).

window-height.$description: Initial height of the OS window.

window-min-height.$description: Minimum window height: at it, even with large text, the section tree still fits without scrolling.

tree-width.$description: Width of the section tree on the left (221 px at a 13 px root; D2: was 195); it grows with the text size so the titles are not cut off.

row-label.$description: Minimum width of the title in a settings row (143 px). In a narrow window the title shrinks and wraps; the keys with the button move under the title only if they do not fit next to a title of this width.

shortcut-slot.$description: Minimum width of the slot for key 'capsules' or the recording field in a shortcut row (117 px). The recording field may be wider and expands to the left (the group is pressed to the right), while the row height and the button positions do not change during recording.

page-width.$description: Largest width of a section page's content (546 px; D2: was 520): text lines do not stretch in a wide window.

min-width.$description: Minimum width of the context menu (182 px at a 13 px root).

max-width.$description: Largest width of the context menu (312 px): a long chat title is cut off with an ellipsis.

panel-width.$description: Width of the visible quick capture panel (a rounded 'pill') in logical pixels. The size is in px and does not grow with the text size: the window is created by Rust, the values must match it.

shadow-margin.$description: A transparent margin around the panel inside the OS window: the shadow is drawn in it (shadow.overlay: offset 8 px + blur 24 px). The capture window is transparent and has no system shadow, the whole look of the panel is in CSS.

window-width.$description: Width of the OS window: panel-width + 2 × shadow-margin (checked by the configuration test). The window height adapts to the content (the capture_resize command), the top of the window stays in place.

window-height.$description: Initial height of the OS window in tauri.conf.json (one empty field: 58.5 px of the panel + 2 × 32 px of shadow margin = 122.5 px at a 13 px root, rounded up to 123 px, like the height the page reports to the capture_resize command; D2: the button is taller, was 122). The value matches tauri.conf.json (checked by the configuration test); after that the page reports the content height to Rust.

window-min-height.$description: The lower limit of the window height that Rust accepts from the page (capture_resize): below any content, a guard against zero and negative values. Matches the constant in Rust (checked by a test).

window-max-height.$description: The upper limit of the window height (capture_resize): above it the content scrolls in the field, and old context plates go past the top edge. Enough for an open emoji picker (its panel is 351 px) above the field with room left for context. Matches the constant in Rust (checked by a test).

field-max-share.$description: Up to what share of the panel height at the tallest window (window-max-height minus two shadow margins) the input field in the capture window grows; beyond that it scrolls inside the field, and old context plates go past the top edge. The share is chosen so that the field limit stays the same (187 px) when the window became taller for the emoji picker.

field-lines-with-picker.$description: How many text lines the input field of the capture window shows while the emoji picker is open; longer text scrolls inside the field. The picker and the field together must fit in window-max-height.

window-narrow.$description: Width of the 'narrow window' of the capture in Storybook stories (together with the shadow margins): a check that the hint, the error and long entries do not break the layout. The window itself is window-width.

entry-lines.$description: How many text lines a pale context entry shows; the rest is cut off with an ellipsis (line-clamp).

size.$description: A key 'capsule' in a shortcut row: minimum width and height (21 px at a 13 px root); long names (Space, F12) grow in width.

height.$description: The import progress bar (6.5 px): a quiet line under the '3 200 of 15 000' row.

list-max-height.$description: Largest height of the chat list in the import window (286 px at a 13 px root): a full export may contain hundreds of personal chats, the list scrolls inside the window.

snippet-lines.$description: How many lines of the snippet a search result row shows; the rest is cut off with an ellipsis (line-clamp).

filters-gap.$description: The gap between search filters (6.5 px).

height.$description: The height of the app window: the whole window.

narrow.$description: Width of the 'narrow window' in Storybook stories (585 px).
